objective: Quantify whether removing prefill alone can meet the existing 10 s first-final and 6 tok/s M4 session targets.
alternative: The post-prefill interval might already be below 10 s on the relevant 19 incremental requests, leaving prefill as the only binding limit.
inputs: C74 three-pair probe confirmation plus manifest
decision: If the zero-prefill residual exceeds 10 s on a majority of C52b incrementals, prefill-only waves cannot satisfy M4 under a held-fixed post-prefill path. This is arithmetic under an explicit counterfactual, not a prediction for C75 server.
claim_limit: No new model execution, causal attribution, sampling or server performance claim. C74 probe ratios are separate observations and are not transplanted as measured C52b speedups.
